author: CNN
description:
This week, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that the US will target a complex network built by Iran over years to allow its entities to evade Washington’s wide-ranging sanctions. The move comes after six months of a war launched by the US and Israel that has since reached a stalemate amid a lack of diplomatic resolution.

Other developments in the war this week include the deployment of the aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt and Iran putting a bounty on the president’s son, Barron Trump.

Experts speak to CNN on this week’s developments from the Iran war.

description:
Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney vowed “dollar-for-dollar” tariffs in response to the United States’ 50% tariffs on $20 billion in Canadian goods after the two sides failed to reach a trade deal. Carney’s tit-for-tat measures, set to take effect on September 8, will include tariffs on steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp, paper and electronics.

Economic experts spoke to CNN about the potential effects of these tariffs on both sides of the border.

author: CNN
description: The son of an American couple who survived the devastating floods in Nepal is preparing to reunite with his parents. Looking ahead to the reunion, his mother told CNN, "I'm going to hug them and cry because I am an emotional mama." Her son, Vikram Ravi, reflected on the harrowing ordeal, telling Brianna Keilar, "I'm just thankful that I was able to hear her tell me that she's okay, rather than having to go look for her."
title: Son of US couple who narrowly escaped Nepal flood: 'Grateful for the miracle'

author: CNN
description:
Perilous rescue efforts along the China-Nepal border are being complicated by the risk of new flooding or landslides, with authorities in China and Nepal briefly pausing rescue operations Friday due to those fears.

A barrier lake – holding enough water to fill an estimated 1,000 Olympic swimming pools – began overflowing on the China-Nepal border, where it formed after a powerful landslide and torrential flooding devastated the area on Wednesday. A barrier lake is a body of water created by debris damming up a river.

2:29 Scientists explain what happened
3:36 One of the most 'hazard-prone landscapes' on the planet

author: CNN
description:
CNN spoke with three mothers who say social media played a role in their children’s deaths about Meta’s $18 billion settlement of a multistate lawsuit alleging the company intentionally designed addictive platforms that harmed young people’s mental health. 

As part of the settlement with states, Meta agreed to make sweeping changes to Facebook and Instagram and let an independent auditor evaluate how it’s implementing those changes. CNN’s Clare Duffy reports.
title: Did the Meta settlement go far enough?
